description: Header file defining the 'olla_algorithm' class implementing the Outer-layer Link Adaptation (OLLA) algorithm for SNR threshold adjustment in wireless communication systems.

classes.name: ocudu::olla_algorithm
classes.description: Implements the OLLA algorithm to adapt SNR thresholds for target BLER in wireless systems.

methods.name: olla_algorithm
methods.description: Constructor initializing the OLLA algorithm with target BLER, SNR increment step, and maximum SNR offset.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the SNR offset based on ACK/CRC feedback and MCS boundaries.

methods.name: offset_db
methods.description: Returns the current SNR offset in dB.
